rationale: Volt-VAR curve designed to correct t_low (0.94pu base) to 0.95pu via q=+0.142857 injection, keep t_nom (1.0pu base) unaffected at q=0, and correct t_high (1.07pu base) to 1.05pu via q=-0.285714 absorption, respecting inverter Q limits (sqrt(100^2-60^2)=80kVAR for t_low/t_high, sqrt(100^2-80^2)=60kVAR for t_nom) and monotonic non-increasing q_fraction.
